newsitem.title: USA: Tektronix sees FY 98 sales, earnings growth.
newsitem.headline: Tektronix sees FY 98 sales, earnings growth.

text.p: Tektronix Inc said Monday it expects fiscal 1998 sales and earnings growth in the range of 10 to 15 percent.
Tektronix said its sales orders and earnings for the year ended May 31, 1997 set all-time records for the company.
The company said a "strong flow of new products", as well as excellent performances in the U.S., the Pacific, and the Americas, fueled another year of good sales growth.
The company said it did not make the progress it had expected in profitability for its video and networking business.

The company said, however, the business's growth rate as it exited the year, the new products it have recently introduced, and the ongoing productivity improvements it is making give it confidence that the investment in this business will be rewarded in fiscal 1998.
The company reported fourth quarter earnings per share of $1.11 compared to $0.86 for the same period a year ago. Fiscal year 1997 earnings per share were 3.48 compared to $3.00 for fiscal year 1996.
